name: SSAO
description: Screen-space ambient occlusion (pre-tonemap, linear scene). Reads gbuffer depth/normals. Distances are WORLD units (1 unit = 1 cm).

uniforms.name: u_radius
uniforms.tip: Sample radius in WORLD units. ~0.02 for a 16 cm vase, ~30 for meter-scale scenes.

uniforms.name: u_power
uniforms.tip: Contrast exponent on the AO term.

uniforms.name: u_bias
uniforms.tip: Depth bias in WORLD units; raise to kill self-shadowing acne (~5% of radius).
